about: Reviewed capability aliases for docs/codemap/BY-CAPABILITY.md. Each entry names a capability in plain words, the synonyms a reader may search for, and the source files that implement it. Every target is a repo-relative path of a file the code map lists; scripts/codemap/codemap.py marks a target it cannot find and reports it (CODEMAP-ALIAS-MISSING). Add an entry when a capability is hard to find by the words its code uses. The note says what the code does, from its own doc comments.

aliases.capability: run work on another of the owner's machines
synonyms: send a call to another node
a phone uses the MacBook's model
aliases.note: OF-575, owner ruling MESH. route.rs decides where an organ call runs: on this machine, on another node of the owner's that offers the organ, or it waits and says why. mesh/mod.rs sends the call over ALPN oneiron/organ/1 and mesh/serve.rs runs a call that arrives from another node. oneiron_rpc/mesh sends a model call to the first of the owner's nodes that takes it.

machine_enroll.rs lands a host MACHINE enrollment: one EnrollDevice and its BindActor. mesh_machine/enrolment.rs makes the mesh binding when a machine link is redeemed: the host checks the joining machine's endpoint key and both binding proofs before it mints anything.

synonyms: quote, reserve, checkpoint, stop, settle, resume
aliases.note: CROSS-ARCH-0023 C2. A job runs as chunks: each chunk is quoted on a host offer, reserved through the run admission, created at the provider under an idempotency key, then stepped by the host (checkpoints at 50, 80 and 95 percent, a stop only after a checkpoint, a resume from it). A chunk settles its billed time at confirmed termination, never above its quote.

synonyms: resume a run on another machine
the run's machine closes or vanishes
fall back to the home node
aliases.note: FIX 4747 slice 6, CROSS-ARCH-0019 "Where work runs" items 02-05: a run on another machine falls back to the home node when that machine closes and resumes from its last finished step; with no machine to take it, it pauses and resumes on the next machine that comes up.

aliases.capability: budget lease of a model call
aliases.note: backend.rs defines BudgetLease, the opaque admission token the budget guard issues. budget/settlement.rs settles a lease's usage (entry BudgetGuard::settle_usage).

aliases.capability: resident share of the host-paid allocation
aliases.note: ARCH-0011 #budget-lease, FIX 7767. run_admission/resident.rs admits a call against its resident's soft share: a call past the share is admitted and its overdraft writes a receipt; only a share the owner pinned refuses new paid work. llm/budget/resident.rs is the durable ledger the admission reads and charges.

aliases.capability: spend cap of a launch and its sub-agents
aliases.note: OF-532, ARCH-0079 #budget: a root scope holds the cap the customer set at the launch's start; every agent the launch starts reserves a child scope under its parent's.
ARCH-0003 #learning-views, ARCH-0079 #scoring: a view over team receipts keyed by scope, task type, pattern, model ids, team shape and who decided; it feeds the planner card.
